mainEntity.name: How long does a typical stone patio installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stone patio installation varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and the type of stone chosen. A smaller, straightforward patio might take 3-7 days, while larger, custom designs with intricate patterns or extensive site preparation could extend to 2-4 weeks. Factors like weather conditions, material availability, and necessary grading or drainage work also influence the timeline. Our team provides a detailed project schedule after an initial site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a stone patio varies by size and complexity, generally ranging from 3 days for small projects to 4 weeks for larger, custom designs. Site conditions and weather also play a role.
